description: A property storage whose Version is 0x53505332 instead of 0x53505331
notes: The shell link itself is well formed, so ShellLink::parse and the ExtraData walk both succeed -- which is why this fixture expects "ok". Walking the store is what fails: PropertyStore::storages yields ErrorKind::BadMagic. Version is the only hard check in the property store, and it is there so a mis-sized block cannot be read as a storage with sixteen bytes of something else for a format ID.
